% footnote-parity.tex -- acceptance gate (footnote-block parity):
% the d-tate footnote block micro-layout vs the uplatex consensus,
% measured at the INK level with pymupdf (the same pattern as
% savepos-anchor-pdf.tex; the runner compiles the SAME file under
% pdflatex and uplatex and runs tests/check-footnote-parity.py).
%
% Anchors (all single glyphs, found by codepoint):
%   あ : the first body glyph = the shared logical origin
%   ☆ : the FIRST glyph of the footnote text = the fn text column head
%   （ : the footnote opener （１） bracket = the fn mark column head
%   rule : the thin vertical drawing = the footnote rule
% The checker locates each anchor's ink box in the reading frame,
% aligns the あ origins, and asserts:
%   - fn text column head: |Δ| <= 0.5pt (cross position of ☆)
%   - fn opener: |Δ| <= 0.5pt (cross position of the fn-area （）
%   - fn rule cross position: |Δ| <= 0.5pt
%   - rule length: |Δ| <= 0.5pt
%   - rule -> text column gap: |Δ| <= 0.5pt
% (the pre-fix residuals were: rule -8.54pt, text -1.72pt, opener
% -3.71pt at 10pt; docs/pdftex-internals.md の縦組み脚注パリティ表.)
\documentclass[pdflatex,tate,paper=a5]{jlreq}
\pagestyle{empty}
\begin{document}
あ\footnote{☆脚注本文。いちにさん。}\typeout{FNPAR: probing}%
\end{document}
